title: Console action runtime does not supply the spec-declared ${ctx.org.*}: action targets interpolate an empty org id
body:
## Source

Found by the cloud#2434 dev while implementing item 3, the welcome page 「邀请成员」 CTA. Reported in PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2451 on 2026-09-28. Epic objectstack-ai/cloud#2440.

## Seam

`spec:ActionSchema.target` declares `${ctx.org.id}` (`ui/action.zod.ts`). The renderer side is objectui app-shell `useConsoleActionRuntime` (`actionProviderProps.context`) together with core `ActionRunner.buildInterpolationContext`.

## What breaks

The console action runtime supplies `activeOrganization`, not the spec-declared `org`. `ActionRunner.buildInterpolationContext` reads `context.org ?? context.organization`. So `${ctx.org.id}` interpolates to an empty string. Measured by the dev at objectui pin `efead6c6` and on objectui `main` `9f0c84a4`.

Consequence: cloud cannot point its 「邀请成员」 CTA at `/apps/cloud_control/sys_organization/record/${ctx.org.id}`. That page is where invitations happen. Today the CTA lands on a generic list with no invite affordance.

## Direction

The dev's recommendation, which the epic PM accepts: supply the spec-declared `org` key in `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s provider context (one line). It must not require cloud to use the undeclared `${ctx.activeOrganization.id}`.

## Acceptance

1. An action target `${ctx.org.id}` resolves to the active organization's id in the console.
2. A test pins that resolution.
3. The follow-up on objectstack-ai/cloud#2434 item 3 (retargeting the CTA) can then land in cloud.
